_about: Hand-curated evidence from public web research. The daily run appends/refreshes entries (see RUNBOOK.md). value_gpu_hr is USD per GPU-hour. kind: index | published_commit | press | vendor_claim. confidence: high | medium | low.

evidence.claim: Silicon Data B200 rental index opened September 2026 at $5.62/GPU-hr, up 27.6% year to date (August range $5.58-$5.69).
Silicon Data B200 rental index at $5.48/GPU-hr at end of March 2026.
Ornn Compute Price Index B200 at ~$4.95/hr in April 2026, up from ~$2.31 in early March (spot-market based).
Secondary report: Ornn B200 index moved from $6.58 to $9.76/GPU-hr between late July and late October 2026.
Third-party price index lists B200 whole-node reserved at ~$4.85 (12-mo) and ~$4.50 (24-mo); 36-month cluster offers ~$5.32-$6.32/GPU-hr.
CoreWeave lists HGX B200 at $68.80/node-hr ($8.60/GPU) on demand and advertises reserved discounts of up to 60%; ~$3.44 is the implied floor, not a confirmed price.
Silicon Data B300 rental index FAQ states $6.95/GPU-hr; the same page's index widget showed $7.67 on Nov 15, 2026 (static FAQ text likely lags).
GetDeploying: median B300 on-demand price rose ~15% over 90 days to ~$9.50/GPU-hr as of Nov 12, 2026.
Vendor guide: committed/bulk B300 capacity runs ~$7-$12/GPU-hr.
Akash marketplace lists B300 from ~$6.00/GPU-hr on demand ($48/hr per 8-GPU HGX node).
AWS raised EC2 Capacity Blocks for ML prices by ~20% in 2026 (third-party reporting).
CME and Silicon Data announced H100/B200 rental-index futures; CME released non-tradable forward-curve data to subscribers in Oct 2026 (not free).
ICE lists an Ornn Compute Price Index (OCPI) B200 future (spec dated Oct 6, 2026).

forecast_assumptions._about: Monthly drift assumptions (log-price change per month). Analog = prior-generation depreciation pattern; momentum = recent market trend, decays with a 3-month half-life. Edit with care and note the reason in 'notes'.

B200.notes: Analog from the H100 path (H100 neocloud index now ~$2.5-3.1/GPU-hr vs ~$8 at 2023 launch). Momentum: Silicon Data B200 index +27.6% YTD through Aug 2026 (~+3%/mo).

B300.notes: Younger product, slower depreciation early in life. Momentum: GetDeploying median +15% over 90 days to Nov 12, 2026.

RTX PRO 6000.notes: Inference/graphics part with many suppliers; no public index found, so momentum assumed flat.

drivers.text: NVIDIA's next generation (Vera Rubin) ramping through 2026-27 should push Blackwell rental rates down as new capacity lands.
More neoclouds and marketplaces listing B200/B300 widens supply and compresses on-demand spreads.
Rental indices rose sharply through 2026 (Silicon Data, Ornn): demand from frontier training/inference is still outrunning supply.
Hyperscalers raised short-term reservation prices (AWS Capacity Blocks ~+20% in 2026).
Exchange-listed futures (CME, ICE) are new; forward curves exist but are not free, so this forecast cannot use them directly.
